scope: Frozen full scientific review contracts, completion semantics, validator and regression suite; not acceptance of an unwritten scientific candidate.
checkedSemantics: All67 required inputs and exactlyQ01–Q15 bound to pinned map.
Missingness and source completion separate; unchecked/unavailable required work cannot complete.
Not-reported follows complete required source inspection; bounded terminal negative findings can be assessed with explicit reasons.
Required available assets hash-verified; every assigned source unit accounted for and every experiment/result/claim graph linked.
Exact numeric scalar matching, qualified values retained, unauthorized graph/calculated estimates excluded.
Exact candidate/plan/assignment/source hashes and distinct case-normalized author/auditor required for accepted_private.
Human approval and public release remain false.
trustBoundaries: A declared unit inventory does not prove that it covers every actual source section; independent scientific inspection must check it.
Passing schema/numeric-token checks does not establish semantic accuracy or causality; every answer, result and numerical claim must be read against source.
